question: Kevin needs vitamins to supplement his diet. He needs to get at least 25 units of vitamin A and 40 units of vitamin B everyday. In order to do so, he can buy capsules named Special Formula and One Daily. Each capsule of Special Formula contains 4 units of vitamin A and 5 units of vitamin B. Each capsule of One Daily contains 3 units of vitamin A and 7 units of vitamin B. If the cost per Special Formula capsule is $0.50 and the cost per One Daily capsule is $0.20, how many of each should he buy to minimize his cost?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # Costs per capsule ($)
    "cost_S": 0.50,
    "cost_O": 0.20,
    # Vitamin A content per capsule
    "vitA_S": 4,
    "vitA_O": 3,
    # Vitamin B content per capsule
    "vitB_S": 5,
    "vitB_O": 7,
    # Daily requirements
    "req_A": 25,
    "req_B": 40,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Decision variables: number of capsules (non-negative integers)
    model.x_S = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.x_O = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: minimize total cost
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=d["cost_S"] * model.x_S + d["cost_O"] * model.x_O,
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    # (1) Vitamin A requirement
    model.vitA = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=d["vitA_S"] * model.x_S + d["vitA_O"] * model.x_O >= d["req_A"]
    )

    # (2) Vitamin B requirement
    model.vitB = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=d["vitB_S"] * model.x_S + d["vitB_O"] * model.x_O >= d["req_B"]
    )

    return model

    "vitA_requirement": 25,
    # "... and 40 units of vitamin B everyday."
    "vitB_requirement": 40,
    # "Each capsule of Special Formula contains 4 units of vitamin A ..."
    "vitA_per_Special": 4,
    # "... and 5 units of vitamin B."
    "vitB_per_Special": 5,
    # "Each capsule of One Daily contains 3 units of vitamin A ..."
    "vitA_per_OneDaily": 3,
    # "... and 7 units of vitamin B."
    "vitB_per_OneDaily": 7,
    # "the cost per Special Formula capsule is $0.50"
    "cost_Special": 0.50,
    # "... and the cost per One Daily capsule is $0.20"
    "cost_OneDaily": 0.20,
}

# Capsule types and nutrient names (structural, not numeric data).
CAPSULES = ["Special", "OneDaily"]
NUTRIENTS = ["A", "B"]


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=CAPSULES)   # capsule types
    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=NUTRIENTS)  # nutrients

    # --- Decision variables: number of capsules of each type bought ---
    # "how many of each should he buy" -> nonnegatives
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.I, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # --- Parameters built from DATA (per-unit vitamin content) ---
    content = {
        ("Special", "A"): d["vitA_per_Special"],
        ("Special", "B"): d["vitB_per_Special"],
        ("OneDaily", "A"): d["vitA_per_OneDaily"],
        ("OneDaily", "B"): d["vitB_per_OneDaily"],
    }
    requirement = {
        "A": d["vitA_requirement"],
        "B": d["vitB_requirement"],
    }
    cost = {
        "Special": d["cost_Special"],
        "OneDaily": d["cost_OneDaily"],
    }

    # --- Objective: minimize total daily cost ---
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=sum(cost[i] * model.x[i] for i in model.I),
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    # --- Constraints: meet each nutrient requirement (at least) ---
    def nutrient_rule(m, n):
        return sum(content[(i, n)] * m.x[i] for i in m.I) >= requirement[n]

    model.nutrient_con = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=nutrient_rule)

    return model
